# DocumentOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for creating a [`Document`](document.md).

The `settings` / `metadata` split is deliberate and binding: it mirrors the document model and the C# surface (`doc.Settings.X` / `doc.Metadata.X`), so an option path here and a property path there are the same path. Flattening `title`/`conformance`/… to the top level would invent a TypeScript-only grouping with no neutral-spec counterpart.

Each half accepts either an instance or its own options literal, so no sub-type import is needed to configure a document.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`metadata`](#metadata): Document metadata; accepts an instance or an options literal.
- [`settings`](#settings): Document settings; accepts an instance or an options literal.

### `metadata`

```typescript
metadata?: DocumentMetadata | DocumentMetadataOptions | undefined
```

*optional*

Document metadata; accepts an instance or an options literal.

### `settings`


Document settings; accepts an instance or an options literal.
